caption: What is the Irish Intern Year? It's the first paid year working as a doctor, and graduates compete for a limited number of HSE intern posts. For eligible EU graduates — such as graduates of Bulgarian medical schools — the route back can instead involve Medical Council registration and applying for SHO posts because the degree includes its own internship. No automatic job, and no honest adviser can guarantee one. Comment DOCTOR and I'll send you the free 15-minute call link. No pitch, no pressure.
